value.rationale: The whiskered complete graph is a canonical corona family, and the exact Roman domination polynomial gives every weight count, not just the optimum. The compact factorization and total \(7^n-4^n+3^n\) arise from a structural all-function classification and provide a reusable benchmark for Roman-domination-polynomial work.
